question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parameswaran Iyer.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Parameswaran Iyer **was the **Chief Executive Officer** of **NITI Aayog **in **June 2022.**
 
• 
 **Shri B.V.R. Subrahmanyam** joined as **new CEO **of **NITI Aayog **on **25.02. 2023.​**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. P. K. Mishra** is currently serving as the **Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister **of India.
 
• **Ramesh Chand **is a member of **NITI Aayog **and serves as the **Chairman of the Committee on Doubling Farmers' Income**.
 
• **Narendra Kumar Kashyap **is **not a known** personality in the Indian political or bureaucratic circles.
 
• Hence, the statement is correct that **Parameswaran Iyer** has been appointed as the new Chief Executive Officer o**f NITI Aayog in June 2022.**
